analysis:
This batch contains only changelog fragments and one architecture doc (docs/architecture/hardware-support.md); no executable source is changed, so there is no concrete security regression evidence here. The prose describes behavior in other files that this batch does not include.

Items for later passes (none are findings):
- GLM-5.3-Flash prefix cache (changelog glm53-native-prerequisites.md lines 9, 21): the encrypted SSD prefix store defaults on for the pinned GLM identity. This falls under T-041/TB-007, which describes the SSD tier as default-on for CBv2 models with per-donation gating. Image and video rows are said to never reuse cached prefixes. The code is not supplied, so the cacheSalt/HMAC scoping and the donation gate for GLM are unverified.
- Line 21 adds a DEBUG-only DARKBLOOM_DEBUG_CACHE_KEY_FILE path that takes a persistent cache key from a file, and says release builds do not contain it. This is unverified and would bypass the SE-rooted KEK if it leaked into release builds (T-041).
- Lines 21 and 8: new `detail=` strings in /metrics and new retained-fault metrics are local only. A check is needed that no prompt-derived data appears in them (A-001).
- glm53-video-input.md: new inline video decoding of untrusted consumer media (TB-007; compare T-050 on temp-file plaintext). Whether decoding avoids temp files and how decoder resource limits are enforced is unverified. The doc states a 512 MiB frame cap and 400 refusals.
- local-responses-continuation.md and hardware-support.md lines 35-42: local Responses history is held in memory by an LRU plus a separate SDK store with no matching eviction. Prompt plaintext (A-001) therefore persists in process memory longer and unboundedly. It does not survive restart and is stated to be local mode, but it is a memory-growth/DoS surface in local direct mode.
- Line 14: GLM is served in coordinator mode with new capability `glm5_next_v1`. Hardware-gating and attestation implications are unverified and platform-owned (TB-002).
- MiMo schema parity and the SSD test-volume change are docs-only and test-only.
